title: Stalwart unattended bootstrap scripts
description: scripts/stalwart-up.sh / stalwart-down.sh: podman run the image pinned by digest, 127.0.0.1 only, ephemeral volume; pin admin via STALWART_RECOVERY_ADMIN; config enabling a local internal directory; create two test accounts via the management API; wait until /.well-known/jmap answers; print URL and credentials. Research Stalwart 0.16 config and management API first.
